## About
Onsite Auto Repair is a family owned shop in Plano. We do state inspections and general auto repair, from brakes and batteries to steering, suspension and air conditioning.
Robert and Jason have been working on some of our customers' cars for years. Reviewers mention accurate diagnosis, an estimated cost up front and timely updates while their car is in the shop.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 106 Google reviews. Give us a call or stop by during the week or on Saturday morning.

## Services
- State inspection: State inspections alongside our regular repair work.
- 29-point general inspection: Covers everything from tires, brakes and alignment to the suspension.
- Brakes: New pads, rotors and brake fluid refills. A full range of brake service so you're not waiting for the screeching.
- Tune-up service: We evaluate and replace electronic engine components that need repair to bring back power and efficiency.
- Batteries and electrical: We can look over your vehicle's electrical system, handle maintenance and replace your battery.
- Air conditioning performance: We test your air conditioning system for refrigerant leaks and check the interior cabin temperature.
- Steering and suspension: Shocks, struts, bushings, wheel bearings, power steering and more. Bring it in if you notice noise over bumps, bouncing, hard turning or uneven tire wear.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do state inspections?
A: Yes. We do state inspections as well as general auto repair.

Q: How often should I have my brakes checked?
A: Every 12 months or 15,000 miles, or on the interval your vehicle's manufacturer recommends for how you drive.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday morning from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
